exposure: implementation of a care bundle (antenatal information to women, manual perineal protection and mediolateral episiotomy when indicated)
cohort: The cohort included 55,060 women with singleton live births between October 2016 and March 2018.
finding: Implementation of a care bundle consisting of antenatal information, manual perineal protection, and mediolateral episiotomy when indicated was associated with a reduction in obstetric anal sphincter injury rates without affecting caesarean section or episiotomy rates.
